stem: A scout observes yellowing on three plants but finds no pathogen sign. Which record is most defensible?
choices: Confirmed fungal disease on three plants.
Yellowing observed on three identified plants; cause unresolved, with follow-up comparison/testing planned.
Nutrient deficiency confirmed because yellowing is nutritional.
No record is needed until a diagnosis is known.
rationale: Observation should be recorded separately from causal interpretation when evidence does not support a confirmed diagnosis.
